iterationCount.name: Downsample passes
iterationCount.description: Number of downsample passes (1-4). Lower values mean faster but lower quality blur.
iterationCount.description[zh_CN]: 降采样次数（1-4）。值越低速度越快但模糊质量越低。

disableNormalWindowBlur.name: Disable blur on normal windows
disableNormalWindowBlur.description: When enabled, ordinary (NET::Normal) windows are not blurred; docks, dialogs and other window kinds keep their blur.
disableNormalWindowBlur.description[zh_CN]: 开启后普通（NET::Normal）窗口不再模糊；任务栏、对话框等其它类型窗口保留模糊。
